title: Bounded sampling and physical tolerance mapping
title_zh: 有界抽样及物理公差映射
query: Generate 16 samples of 72 independent variables using each of MC,LHS,Sobol,Halton. All marginals are standard normal conditioned on [-1,1], not clipped normal or uniform. Use sample_test once per method, seed=20261104. Submit four artifact IDs and physical values for the first MC vector. First42 are Z shape changes (0.15a mm), next6 prelift (.3348+0.15a mm), final24 alternating X,Y per 12 rigid CORE terminals (0.1a mm). SUB is unchanged; translation preserves terminal dimensions.
scoring: binary: all independent checks required; no self-report scoring
